reason: Comparison with the Latin confirmed and corrected the first reading's connected lines and established the order of the faces, showing that the 'treatise' is a verse translation of the Vision of Tundale.

SOURCE-ASSISTED READING of F-rjkx (Antwerpen, UB, MAG-P 64.74), made after comparison with the Visio Tnugdali, ed. A. Wagner (Erlangen 1882), pp. 36-41 (archive.org VisioTnugdaliWagner, leaves n115-n120). Lines reread on the image by a research reader: canvas 3 col b (whole), canvas 2 col a (whole), canvas 1 col b (whole), canvas 0 col a lower half. The cut columns (canvas 0 col b, canvas 1 col a, canvas 2 col b, canvas 3 col a) were not reread and rest on the image-only first reading. ( ) = expansion, [ ] = lost at the edge or supplied, ? = uncertain. Language: Anglo-Norman, octosyllabic couplets.

Canvas 3 (fol. [2]v), col b, box 760,340-1420,2010 (Wagner 41,1-17)
E puys a ioye mener seyunt?
   Puys sen sunt aler auant
   E vindret a une porte g(ra)nt
Ke de gre lur est ouerte
Puys veyent une place aperte
De bon odur fu replenie
Tre bel esteyt de flurs flurie
Des almes tant replenie esteyt
Ke le numbre nul ne saueyt
Lumere i esteyt e ioye g(ra)nt
Soleyl ni fu resplendisant
Ke ennuy feyst . for ke solaz
E ceo ne se resconseyt pas
De ewe? (written like "elbe") viue i out funteyne
Q(ua)nt lalme le veyt g(ra)nt ioye mene
Ke tant de peyne fu eschape
Come auant aveyt asae
Par g(ra)nt deuocion ad dit
Honure seez vus ih(es)u crist
De ci ke a remenant du mund
Deuant trestotes choses ke sunt
Car par sa merci ca me ad mene
De portes de mort me ad diliuere
E entre ses seynz me ad amene
U tant sui ore baude e lee
Ore say ke ceo est uerite
Ke seynte escripture ad chante
Ke oyl ne ad vu ne oreyl oye
Ne quer de home nel entendu[t]
Ceo ke deus ad atorne
A ceus ke finement le unt ame
Puys ad al le angele demand[e]

Canvas 2 (fol. [2]r), col a, box 340,250-1030,1940 (Wagner 38,17-39,4); first letters lost at the left edge
[Q]uele chose est [a]ngele? ke deu done
[M]es malement usent li home
[Q](ua)nt poer de deu lur est g(ra)nte
[E] il a diable seruunt de gre
[U]nkore ad li alme demande
Pur quey ne ad n(ost)re sire done
[P]oer al bons de amender
[L]ur subiecs ke veyent errer
[E] feyssent de eus amendes g(ra)nt
[L]e angele respont meyntenant
[A] bone fere est auenu?
[Al] bons est poer tolu
[P]ur peche de autre gent
[K]e ne unt cure de amendement
[P]ur ceo ne unt pas deserui[e]
[Ke] il eyent p(ru)dhome ke les chastie
[E] ceo est meynte fere auenu
[...]ient en t(er)re le a?m? deu
[B]one fere p(ur) ...? les bons
[K]e deus en ad chosi p(ur) soens
[K]il plus estreytement veyent
[E] de lur saluacion p(ur)veyent
[Unco]re demand le alme de cel malfe
[Ke] est de tenebres p(ri)nce apelle
[Pur] quey ceo est car nul defendre
[N]e put . fors ke a tut mal rendre
[N]e seymemes deliuerer ne put
[L]e angele li dit sufrir? li estoyt
[P]ur ceo est p(ri)nce apellez
[Ke p]rimerement prent le delices?
(last lines in stained band, not read)

Canvas 1 (fol. [1]v), col b, box 730,260-1470,1930 (Wagner 38,4-17)
[.]i ke sunt le pecheors g(ra)nt
Ke soleyent fere les deu maunt? (stained)
Come homicide . advltrie
Larcin . orgoyl . e trecherie
E les autres ke mortels sunt
Dunt entre penaunce ne funt
Trestote les peynes en unt il eu
Avant ke seyent ica venu
Ke auant veystes . ore est atant
Ke ci sunt tuz iors demorant
E les prelaz ke entre sunt
Ke p(ur) mestre desirez unt
Prelacie . nent p(ur) valer
Ne p(ur) les almes de gent sauuer
Mes p(ur) beiuere e p(ur) manger
E p(ur) le graz chiuals errer
La gent ennuyre e greuer
Pur lur volentez espleyter
Ne volent ben fere mes damage
Ke les bons ne volent sustenir
Come mercenarie unt fuir
Les malueys unt losenganz
Q(ua)nt les veyent les bons greuanz
Le poer ke deu lur ad done
Solum deu ne le unt use
Car li uns par charnalite g?uent
Les autres par fauur esparnient
Dunt les deheez sufferunt tuz iors
Come seynt escripture dit aliors
Les mals puyssaunz puyssante[ment]
[...] lieure? a lur turment (stained)
[..]ut ure? sire poer done (stained)
[...] me ameneres? ke a ce[ (stained)

]es de meyns plusors aueyt
]de cue hiduse esteyt
]la cue aueyt mil meyns
]chetone? seyer? certeyns
[C]ent paumees de lungure
